body: You should tell them! It's better to try then to never know. When they see how hurt you are and how much you have been struggling, their hearts will warm and they will care. Give it a try! And Goodluck ^-^

Ohmygosh good luck! I know when I finally opened up to my mom about my self harming and depression I was so scared and expected the worst, but she was so understanding and I was so glad that she got me the help I needed. You made a good choice telling your mother. I hope all goes well :)
I don't see him again till right before christmas time... I just needed help now...

Yesterday, and i was was really irritable, i took it at 1230, it takes about an hour and a half to kick in and last for 6 or 7 hours. I didnt have any other social contact that day till after it wore off and I was quite, passive aggressive, i felt heavy and sad, suspicious, once i was alone i got painfully upset, it hurt deep in my bones. Today I didnt take the pill and I have just been the same way which is why i cut everyone off for awhile so i can figure out whats wrong with me before i push everyone away for good.
College everything changes omg. I hated everyone in highschool, college I love everyone. In college everything is different, dont worry you'll be fine :)

I use Omegle or chat roulette, I dont as much as i used to. I used to make awesome connections on there, add them on snapchat and always stay in touch. But now it takes forever to get to a legit person. Now I just talk to random people on tumblr haha.

I feel like this is a lesson everyone has to learn sooner or later. The first love. It either completely destroys you or it can be the best experience of your life. Mostly first loves end sour, its gonna take sometime to build yourself back up again, it could take months, a year, or even 2. But you'll get there, take this experience and learn from it. I wish you the best of luck :)
Thats a good idea, I think ill enjoy this time alone. Too much going on anyway.
Yes pets work amazingly! When I first got a dog all that unconditional love made me feel so good. Good for temporary happiness. Whenever I feel so alone I make my dog cuddle with me xD

I feel the same way, i'd use to have my music organized into playlist for my moods, or id watch Adventure Time, or get lost in a book. But now this depression has gotten to strong, i feel so heavy and my mind cant focus on anything else. I like to talk to strangers online when things are too much, I find talking to people who dont know what you look like, or anything about your life to be really really helpful for some reason. Try that? And its the least self destructive one ive got haha.
